title: Future Highlight Zone stars shine at MVP Basketball's All-Star Classic - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen ,
1 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – Basketball fans in Fort Wayne got an early look at some future Highlight Zone stars on Wednesday.
MVP Basketball hosted their annual All-Star Classic at the Boys & Girls Club of Fort Wayne. The showcase included a futures game, a 3-point shootout and the main all-star contest involving the best middle school players in northeast Indiana.
In the Futures Game, Team Rim Wreckers rolled to a 104-58 win over Team Jammers. Clayton Taulbee was named MVP of the Futures Game after leading Team Rim Wreckers in scoring.
Emmitt Neely won the 3-point shootout over Joe Miller after hitting 16 triples in the final round.
In the main All-Star game, Team MVP defeated Team Midwest America with an 89-85 win. Landon Woodson earned most valuable player honors.
